BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token. Create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) (send /newbot) and paste the token it gives you, like 123456:ABC-DEF...

NOTPANEL_API_KEY.description: Your NotPanel API key (starts with np_live_). Create it on the [NotPanel API page](https://notpanel.com/developers). This app only works with NotPanel.

OWNER_IDS.description: Optional. Comma-separated Telegram user IDs that are always admins (get yours from [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot)). Leave empty to claim admin from the setup page instead.
